description: This is a high-impact, vintage-style propaganda poster titled “PEPEPREVAILS” in massive, bold white block letters with a black outline across the top. The entire artwork is framed like an aged, weathered collectible card with ornate gold filigree borders, giving it a battle-worn, historical feel. The scene is a chaotic, post-apocalyptic battlefield under a dark, smoky teal-green sky. Burning tanks, wrecked military vehicles, flames, and explosions fill the background. A glowing, electric-green Bitcoin “₿” symbol dominates the upper right, crackling with energy and casting a winding green energy trail across the devastation. In the foreground stands a larger-than-life Pepe the Frog soldier as the central hero: •  He wears a torn, blood-stained military vest with the patch “BITCOIN OR BUST”. •  An American flag bandana is tied around his head. •  His left eye is covered by a purple bruise/eye patch. •  He grips a smoking assault rifle in one hand and a tattered American flag (covered in glowing Bitcoin “₿” symbols) in the other. •  Dog tags hang from his neck, and his camouflage pants are ripped and scorched. Behind him marches an army of smaller Pepe the Frog soldiers in full combat gear, carrying rifles and waving orange flags emblazoned with the Bitcoin “₿” logo and circular “17” insignias. American flags wave among the troops. The overall vibe is defiant, patriotic, and crypto-themed — a full-scale “frog army” rising through the ruins. At the bottom of the asset, in bright dripping yellow text that looks like it’s melting or bleeding, is the scammer’s Bitcoin address that swept the user’s assets: 1AVNETmvp2HG5z9DTmfLquMoV7Z2w2A5dDq Directly beneath it, in bold, blood-red dripping capital letters, it screams:  SCAMMER ADDRESS This address is the focal point of the entire poster — deliberately placed and styled to be impossible to miss. It serves as the central “call-out” and permanent record of the theft.  created this powerful “PEPEPREVAILS” artwork specifically to document and expose the scammer’s address that drained their assets. I openly acknowledge it was an extremely painful lesson and take full personal responsibility — no excuses. Yet I refuse to stay down. This asset is my rallying cry: the frogs (the Pepe community) will rise up together, continue the fight, and turn this loss into a symbol of resilience and awareness of the Revolution taking place thanks to Bitcoin  The image blends dark humor, meme culture, Bitcoin maximalism, and American grit into one unforgettable warning and battle flag. It’s both a memorial to what was stolen and a declaration that the fight is far from over. PEPEPREVAILS.
